description: Source code implementing HTTP Content-Disposition header parsing and decoding, including RFC 2047 and RFC 5987 encoding handling.

classes.name: HttpContentDisposition
classes.description: Class for parsing and representing HTTP Content-Disposition headers, including filename extraction and encoding decoding.

methods.name: HttpContentDisposition
methods.description: Constructor that parses the header string with optional referrer charset.

methods.name: ConsumeDispositionType
methods.description: Parses the disposition type from the header string.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Main parsing function for Content-Disposition header, extracting filename and disposition type.

methods.name: DecodeQEncoding
methods.description: Decodes a quoted-printable (Q) encoded string as per RFC 2047.

methods.name: DecodeBQEncoding
methods.description: Decodes a Base64 or Q-encoded string as per RFC 2047.

methods.name: DecodeWord
methods.description: Decodes an encoded word, handling RFC 2047, percent-encoding, and charset conversions.

methods.name: DecodeFilenameValue
methods.description: Decodes filename or name parameter value, supporting RFC 2047 and non-ASCII strings.

methods.name: ParseExtValueComponents
methods.description: Parses charset and value components from extended parameter values.

methods.name: DecodeExtValue
methods.description: Decodes extended parameter values following RFC 5987.
